en: A vintage cable telegram form from CABLE AND WIRELESS LIMITED, Athens Branch, printed in red and black. The pre‑printed header includes fields for local number, clerk, date, time, and origin/destination, with typed entries indicating a telegram from Athens to Helsinki on 22 August 1939. The addressee line reads "VEKIARELLI ATHENS." Below, in the message area, there is printed instruction text and several lines of handwritten pencil notes mentioning Olympia, Helsinki, and the 1940 Olympiad.
